title: Secret Area 51 battle saw US soldier killed by reptilian alien, sniper claims
excerpt: A former US Army sniper claims an elite soldier was killed by a reptilian alien during a secret underground energy-weapon battle near Nevada's Area 51
content:
A former US Army sniper claims an elite soldier was killed by a reptilian alien during a secret underground energy-weapon battle near Nevada's Area 51

21:35, 18 Oct 2026Updated 21:35, 18 Oct 2026

A former US Army sniper has claimed that an elite American soldier was killed by a reptilian alien in a secret gunfight near Area 51. Nick Betts, co-host of the Liberty Risk podcast, said an unnamed veteran from the military's Joint Special Operations Command (JSOC) blabbed about the incident during a night of heavy drinking in Poland.

‌

‌

According to Betts, elite troops were summoned from Fort Bragg, North Carolina, and given high-tech energy weapons to hunt three otherworldly invaders that had stormed an underground complex near the legendary Nevada site.

‌

The mission was launched after the top-secret facility went radio silent and a quick-reaction force sent inside vanished without a trace.

Article continues below

Betts said the six-man squad was flown in by Black Hawk helicopter and sent deep into underground tunnels. But disaster struck as soon as they made contact with the alien entity.

"They said that they f****** shot this creature that was bipedal, mildly reptilian-looking but had fingers and was using this weapon system," Betts said.

Before the squad could take it down, the creature unleashed a blast from a directed-energy weapon. "As they're coming around on this outside, the outside left guy gets f****** hosed with one of the guns that they're using like straight to the chest and f****** dies," Betts said.

The veteran sniper, who served in Iraq and Afghanistan, said the squad managed to kill all three reptilians, but the fallout was immediate.

‌

He claims commanders cremated the fallen soldier's body on-site, overriding his squad's protests regarding his Catholic faith, and concocted a fake cover story claiming he perished in a training blast.

‌

Betts described the facility as looking like something out of sci-fi blockbuster Independence Day, featuring biometric hand scanners, iris readers and glass observation decks far beyond the tech level of the Pentagon.

While the story was shared over drinks, Betts insists he realised it was deadly serious the following morning at 6am when a second JSOC veteran allegedly involved in the operation confronted him.

‌

"I would have chalked it up to the wine if it wasn't for being choke slammed up against a f****** wall in the morning at 6am," Betts said. "I'm like, 'Hey, so and so told me you know a thing or two about aliens.'

"Dude, he f****** stops, turns me, grabs me by the f****** neck, and f****** slams me up against the wall. And he's like, 'Nick, I f****** swear to God. Never f****** talk about this again.'"

‌

Betts added that both soldiers immediately pulled out of the documentary they were filming in Poland and cut all contact with him.

The US military and White House have consistently denied the existence of physical evidence for extraterrestrials.

However, claims of reptilian beings have long persisted in UFO lore, with whistleblowers previously hinting that multiple alien species could be interacting with confidential military programmes.
